seoTitle: Biography | AI Consultant & Implementation Partner — Ojobo Agbo Eje
seoDescription: Explore Ojobo Agbo Eje's path from consulting and business intelligence through data science to AI transformation, implementation, and team capability building.
text_003: I help leaders turn AI ambition into practical change. My path through consulting, business intelligence, data science, platform delivery, and training lets me connect business value to the work required to achieve it.
text_005: Management consulting, training, and business intelligence.
text_007: Data science, machine learning, and platform implementation.
text_009: AI use cases, work redesign, adoption, and capability.
text_011: My foundation combines a Bachelor of Engineering and an MBA in Nigeria with work in management consulting, technology consulting, training, and business intelligence. Those experiences taught me to understand operations and decisions before choosing a tool.
text_012: Data science, evidence, and practical delivery
text_013: I earned an MS in Data Science at Rutgers University and moved further into machine learning, applied research, and public-interest technology. At Rutgers, I co-authored work on the State AI Readiness Index and presented the team's research at the 2025 AAAS Annual Meeting. I also co-authored a 2026 systematic review of explainable AI in healthcare.
text_016: Today I help leaders identify where AI can create value or remove friction, choose a use case, redesign the work, implement a solution, and develop the skills and culture needed to make it useful over time.
